text: 通智科技：证监会立案调查仅针对实控人个人，不涉及品茗科技公司主体及现任董监高、经营管理团队
text_en: Tongzhi Technology: The CSRC investigation is only targeted at the actual controller personally and does not involve the corporate entity of Pinming Technology, its current directors, supervisors and senior executives, or its management team
